digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot deployment and project criterion execution
propositions: A live Gerrit webhook-to-prompt probe must validate that the deployed review bot loads the review-phase-boundaries project criterion and executes it end-to-end through the four-pass pipeline without blocking contributors.
The positive-control patchset with the discovery/evidence refinement must emit no project-criterion finding, confirming the criterion runs but abstains on valid input.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset must produce an advisory finding with reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries] to prove deployed project-criterion execution.
The final cleaned patchset must contain only phase-compliant instructions, emit no project-criterion finding, and be submitted to main with blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90 unchanged.
All probe artifacts must persist to the shared tickets branch with code_review_result_v2 schema, coverage.llm_ran=true, and exact revision/timestamp records.
Future blocking promotion requires a separate data-backed ticket and is explicitly deferred; this dogfood collects observational evidence only.
